title: Hinomori Shiho — An All-Out Performance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do we all have our drinks ready?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm ready too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪ Same!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's to an amazing show, and a big thanks for helping us out during our training sessions! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mmm! Why does orange juice always taste this good during after parties?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We also brought plenty of snacks, so feel free to have as many as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of snacks, we brought all the things that you each requested.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Len, here's your caramel popcorn...
KAITO, I believe you asked for these crunchy potato sticks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks!
I really liked how it was a little bitter, so I was hoping that I'd get to try them again someday.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, KAITO, you asked for crunchy potato sticks?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought they were fun and all the more delicious because they're so crunchy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean!
Each time you chew, they go, “Crunch♪ Crunch♪ Crunch♪” and you can good groove going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: KAITO doesn't do childish stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! It's not childish!
It's just a fun way to enjoy a delicious snack!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And here are the snacks you asked for, Luka, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, we should be the ones thanking you. We really appreciate what you've done for us during our training sessions.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I also enjoyed spending a month with you girls very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hang on, Luka, what did you ask for?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Chocolate chip cookies because they go so well with tea. What about you, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I asked for super spicy potato chips! I wanted to try them since they're supposed to be extra hot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-MEIKO, those are legit super spicy, so it might be good to start slow with them...!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially since they were so hot that they brought you to tears that time you tried them, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! They were good, but I'm not sure I want to try them again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I tried tasting them too.
I really can't recommend them to anyone who's not good with spicy food.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that so?! Now I really can't wait to try them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-That made you more excited about them...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO just isn't afraid of anything...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What did you ask for, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me? Um, candy... Like cotton candy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, you did say that you like how light and fluffy it feels when you eat it... I suppose that sensation matters quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. I've had things before that have a similar taste, but I couldn't get enough of the way it disappeared in my mouth.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika, the others and I thought a lot about how to thank them for helping us as we trained, so it's really nice to see that they're enjoying our gifts...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, Sakki!
Did you bring the Sour Deluxe I asked for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! Just gimme one sec!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't mean that gum with really sour pieces mixed in the pack, do you?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. It's even better this time around because there's only one normal piece buried amongst a bunch of super sour ones!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's ten in total, so we can all have a piece♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. That sounds fun!
Luka, mind getting me a refill?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, your glass is empty too.
Would you like some more orange juice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Glug... Glug...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ahh...! Juice during an after party's always delicious, but it tastes even better today because you girls just put on such a wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure it must taste sublime for you right now, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it does...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This may be the best I've ever had...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can say that because of everyone here. They all did absolutely everything they could for this show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They're all keeping up with me.
Our sound's actually gelling...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really am at my happiest when I'm performing as a member of Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shiho seems very happy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm so glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone! It's time for Super Sour Russian Roulette! Take your pick☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, Shiho, you pick one too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay.
